decisions.reason: The mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core offer and cheap to keep, and nothing so far shows its value won't materialize, so the option stays open as it supports parts and service revenue.

The trommel screen is only mentioned on the website, which leaves some uncertainty about how prominent it is, but it is a low-cost extension of a core category in a growing industry, so keeping it is justified.
The new slow-speed shredder line launched in 2024 has its own page and fits the core business, and its uncertainty is still unresolved, so it is too early to abandon this low-cost option.
The spiral shaft screen line is a recent, prominently presented extension of the established screening offer whose market value is not yet revealed, so keeping the option open is the rational choice.
